{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

This soup is comfort food at its best. You know, get all cozy in the sofa, turn on your favorite flick, that kind of thing.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
* 18 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Juice|tomato juice]]
* ½ cup chicken [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], divided
* 1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 2 Roma [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick slices either French or Italian crusty white [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]], cut on the bias
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* 2 large bunches fresh [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]]

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Immersion Blender|Immersion blender]]
* [[Cookbook:Toaster Oven|Toaster oven]]
* Basting brush

== Procedure ==
#Combine paste, juice, cream, broth, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp pepper, and diced tomatoes in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium high heat.
#Reduce heat to medium low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid has reduced by ⅓.
#Using an immersion blender, purée soup until smooth. Keep warm over low heat.
#[[Cookbook:Toasting|Toast]] bread slices in the toaster oven. The second they come out, [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] slices with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic and remaining salt and pepper. Set aside.
#Add basil leaves to tomato purée and let steep for 5 minutes over low heat. Remove leaves.
#Garnish individual bowls with sprigs of basil and serve warm with garlic toast.

steps.text: Combine paste, juice, cream, broth, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp pepper, and diced tomatoes in a large saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium high heat.
Reduce heat to medium low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid has reduced by ⅓.
Using an immersion blender, purée soup until smooth. Keep warm over low heat.
Toast bread slices in the toaster oven. The second they come out, brush slices with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic and remaining salt and pepper. Set aside.
Add basil leaves to tomato purée and let steep for 5 minutes over low heat. Remove leaves.
Garnish individual bowls with sprigs of basil and serve warm with garlic toast.
